name: Edamame (Soybean)

schedule.notes: Soil must be 60+ F. Inoculate seed with soybean-specific rhizobia.
Pick when pods are plump and bright green, before seeds harden. Window is only 1 to 2 weeks per variety.

harvest.cues: Pods 90% filled, bright green, fuzzy. Whole plant matures at once; pull the whole plant.
harvest.storageNotes: Blanch in salted water 5 minutes, then freeze in pods. Fresh in fridge only 1 to 2 days.

varieties.name: Midori Giant
varieties.notes: Large, sweet beans. Bred specifically for fresh eating.

varieties.name: Envy
varieties.notes: Fastest to maturity. Best for short seasons.

notes: Wildlife loves them — deer and rabbits decimate young plants. Row cover is essential until they're 12 in tall. Harvest window is short; succession plant 2 to 3 times.
